mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_token_usage ( trace_id, session_id, user_id, model_name, scenario, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms, success, error_message, input_snippet, output_snippet, called_at ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{modelName}, #{scenario}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{costUsd}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{inputSnippet}, #{outputSnippet}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT model_name AS modelName, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS costUsd FROM llm_token_usage WHERE called_at >= #{since} GROUP BY model_name
SELECT user_id AS userId, SUM(total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(cost_usd) AS costUsd FROM llm_token_usage WHERE called_at >= #{since} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY SUM(cost_usd) DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_token_usage WHERE success = false AND called_at >= #{since}
